sloka: दूतवध्या न दृष्टा हि राजशास्त्रेषु राक्षस ।दूतेन वेदितव्यं च यथार्थं हितवादिना ।। ५.५८.१४७ ।।।।
transliteration: dūtavadhyā na dṛṣṭā hi rājaśāstreṣu rākṣasa ।dūtena veditavyaṁ ca yathārthaṁ hitavādinā ।। 5.58.147 ।।।।

translations.english: 'The royal code prohibits the murder of an emissary. A wellwishing emissary should convey the truth.
